main_text.l: QUOD D. OPT. MAX. FELIX ET FAUSTUM ESSE VELIT.

ISTA, SICUT AB ANIMO CANDIDO ET PACIS ECCLESIARUM SYNCERE STUDIOSO PROFECTA SUNT, OMNIBUS GERMANIÆ ILLUSTRISS. PRINCIPIB. CÆTERISQ. NOBILISS. ORDINIBUS, MAGISTRATIB. ECCLESIARUM PASTORIB. DOCTORIB. ET POPULIS AUGUSTANAM CONFESSIONEM PROFITENTIBUS DICATA SUNT, SINE PRÆIUDICIO, ET ABSQUE ANIMI ACERBITATE, LEGENDA, EXPENDENDA, ET IN LEGITIMO TANDEM CONVENTU COMMUNI, LIBERO, ET LEGITIMO, QUUM DEDERIT DOMINUS, EX PURO DEI VERBO DIIUDICANDA.

page.notes: Library stamp (Bibliotheca Genevensis) omitted as not printed text. Faint show-through of a title ("CONTROVERSIES" and a line below it) omitted. Printed forms kept: "PRINCIPIB.", "MAGISTRATIB.", "PASTORIB.", "DOCTORIB.", "CÆTERISQ.", "PRÆIUDICIO" (printed PRÆIVDICIO, u/v normalised), "DIIUDICANDA" (printed DIIVDICANDA). The "Q" with a tail in QVOD and QVVM is read as a large initial letter. Final word "DIIUDICANDA" is hyphenated at line end in print ("DIIVDICAN-/DA"); written whole here.
